common.tagline: Watching over your pet between vet visits.
common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
common.notAVet: TassuVahti is a support tool. It does not replace a veterinarian.

disclaimer.app: TassuVahti is a support tool. It does not replace a veterinarian.
disclaimer.result: TassuVahti supports you between visits. It does not replace a vet's examination.
disclaimer.firstAid: This is first aid on the way to the vet. It does not replace treatment.
disclaimer.knowledge: Information only. If you are unsure, call a vet or the emergency clinic.

welcome.title: Your vet's advice, turned into a daily care plan.
welcome.watchListRest: made for your pet's diagnosis, logged in 30 seconds a day.
welcome.trafficLightRest: that tells you when it is time to call a vet.
welcome.emergencyRest: on every screen, no sign-in needed.
welcome.helpRest: on every screen, no sign-in needed.

auth.confirmBody: Choose your bank. You only do this once on this device; after that TassuVahti opens with your face, fingerprint or PIN.
auth.whenAskedAgain: We ask again only on a new device, after a long break, or before sensitive changes such as your insurance details.
auth.lockBody: Your session stays on this phone. Pick the lock you use every day.
auth.signOutAnyTime: You can sign this device out any time in Account.
auth.unlockBody: Your pets' logs and reminders are waiting.

prompt.face: Look at your phone to unlock

home.noWatchListBody: Log how {{name}} is doing whenever something seems off.
home.noLogYet: No log yet. Log today to start the watch list for {{name}}.
home.flaggedLastLog: Last log: {{items}}. Log today to see if it settles.
home.flaggedToday: Today: {{items}}. Keep an eye on it and log again tomorrow.
home.asUsualLastLog: {{name}}'s last log was as usual. Log today to keep the streak.
home.asUsualToday: Today's log for {{name}} was as usual.
home.noPetsBody: Each pet gets its own page with a watch list, care plan and health passport.
home.seasonalHint: How to prevent it, and what to watch for

pet.draftVisit: Draft · waiting for the clinic to check it
pet.noVisitsBody: Add the notes from a vet visit to get a care plan.
pet.readMore: Read more in the knowledge base
pet.sharedWith: Shared with {{names}} in your family account

result.greenBody: Everything you logged is as usual today.
result.greenAdvice: Keep logging once a day so changes show up early.
result.yellowBody: Something is not quite as usual. That is something to watch.
result.yellowAdvice: Watch {{name}} closely today and log again tomorrow, in more detail.
result.redBody: Your answers match a reason your vet gave to call right away.
result.whyBody: Based on {{vet}}'s thresholds for this {{condition}}, your latest logs and the current medication. The app suggests; your vet's instructions set the limits.
result.whyBodyGeneral: Based on general limits for appetite, energy, pain and vomiting. Add a vet visit to get limits made for your pet.
result.otherClinics: Other emergency clinics on the map
result.showPassport: Show {{name}}'s health passport to the vet
result.ifUnsure: If you are unsure, call. The clinic can tell you whether to come in.

carePlan.noneBody: Add the notes from {{name}}'s vet visit. We turn them into a plan you can follow at home.
carePlan.pickUp: Sent to {{place}} · remember to pick it up

reminders.familySees: Your family sees the same reminders and ticks.

diet.changeSlowlyBody: Mix a little more of the new food into the old one each day over about a week. A sudden switch can upset the stomach.
diet.weightInvalid: Enter the weight in kilograms, e.g. 4.6

passport.share: Share with a vet or pet care

share.title: Share {{name}}'s passport
share.consent: Anyone with the link or QR code can read what you chose until it expires. You can stop sharing any time in Account.
share.qrA11y: QR code for the share link
share.expires: Expires in {{duration}}. You'll get a notice when it's opened.

photo.title: Move and scale
photo.hintDefault: Take a photo or choose one from your gallery. You can move and scale it before saving.
photo.hintChange: Looks good? Tap Use to save, or pick another one.
photo.footnote: Shown on home, in the pet switcher, reminders and the health passport. Removing a photo also deletes it from storage.

addPet.photoHint: Take a photo or choose one from your gallery. Without one, we show a picture based on species.
addPet.name: Name
addPet.policyFound: We found a pet policy without a profile. Link it to this pet?

addVisit.intro: Add {{name}}'s visit notes. We turn them into a care plan and a watch list.
addVisit.textPlaceholder: Paste or type what the vet wrote: diagnosis, medicine, what to do at home, follow-up.

step.clinic: Waiting for the clinic to check it

addVisit.aiNote: The app only summarises what your vet wrote. It never makes a diagnosis. Until the clinic checks the draft, it is marked "Draft".

map.title: Vets & emergency
map.registryNote: Contracted clinics come from the insurance company's registry.

clinic.directPaymentNote: This clinic settles the insurance claim directly. You only pay the deductible.
clinic.noDirectPaymentNote: Pay at the clinic and make a claim with the receipt afterwards.
clinic.open24hBody: Call ahead so the clinic can prepare.
clinic.notContracted: Not a contracted clinic. Your insurance still covers the visit, but you make the claim yourself.

store.note: Products come from your vet or the insurer's approved list, not from advertising. Prescription medicines go through the prescription, not the store map.

knowledge.title: Is it safe?
knowledge.noResultsBody: Try another name. If your pet ate something unknown, call a vet.
knowledge.sampleNotice: Sample content for the prototype. Vets and poison information experts review every entry before release.

substance.noVomiting: Don't make your pet vomit unless a vet tells you to.
substance.sample: Sample content, not yet reviewed · updated {{date}}

ateThis.amountPlaceholder: Leave empty if you don't know
ateThis.noWeight: Add your pet's weight for a dose-based estimate.
ateThis.noPets: Add a pet to get a species-specific answer.

action.goToEmergencyNow: Go to the emergency clinic now

ateThis.dose: {{amount}} {{unit}} of {{substance}} is about {{mgPerKg}} mg of {{compound}} per kg.
ateThis.noDose: Based on the risk of {{substance}} for a {{species}}, the worst realistic case.

note.noSpeciesData: There is no data for this species, so we treat it as dangerous.
note.amountUnknown: Without the amount, we assume the worst realistic case.
note.weightUnknown: Without your pet's weight, we can't calculate the dose.
note.noDoseData: There is no reliable dose data, so the amount doesn't change the risk.

alerts.title: Seasonal alerts
alerts.logMatch: {{names}}'s recent log mentions a symptom from this card. Keep an eye on it.
alerts.none: No alerts for your pets this season
alerts.maintained: Cards are filtered by your pets' species. Content is maintained by a veterinarian.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.body: No sign-in needed. If your pet is in danger, call the emergency clinic first.

firstAid.title: First aid
firstAid.intro: Step-by-step guides for the way to the vet. Choose your pet's size: the technique depends on it.
firstAid.rhythmHint: Press to the beat: {{bpm}} a minute. After 30 presses, give 2 breaths.
firstAid.sample: Sample guide, not yet reviewed by a vet

insurance.directPaymentNote: Contracted clinics with direct payment: no need to claim afterwards.
insurance.bankIdNote: Changing policy details asks for bank ID again.

settings.title: Account
settings.familyHint: Everyone in the family account sees the same pet pages and reminders.

notify.locationHint: e.g. blue-green algae or poisoning warnings nearby

settings.noShares: You are not sharing a passport right now.
settings.vetConsent: Share visit data with my vet
settings.vetConsentHint: Lets the clinic check care plans and send visit notes
settings.privacyNoticeHint: How your and your pets' data is used (GDPR)
settings.signOutHint: Signing out removes the session from this phone. You'll need online banking to sign in again.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be old. Go back home to continue.

placeholder.notBuilt: This screen is not built yet.

bankAuth.title: Confirm it’s you
bankAuth.intro: Choose your bank. You only do this once on this device; after that TassuVahti opens with your face, fingerprint or PIN.
bankAuth.note: We ask again only on a new device, after a long break, or before sensitive changes such as your insurance details.
bankAuth.loadError: Couldn’t load the list of banks.
bankAuth.signInError: Sign-in didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.

setLock.title: How should TassuVahti open?
setLock.intro: Your session stays on this phone. Pick the lock you use every day.
setLock.footnote: You can sign this device out any time in Account.
setLock.confirmPrompt: Confirm to turn on the lock
setLock.biometricFailed: That didn’t work. Try again or choose a PIN.
setLock.pinMismatch: The PINs didn’t match. Choose a PIN again.
setLock.saveError: Couldn’t save the lock. Try again.

unlock.faceHint: Look at your phone to unlock
unlock.wrongPinAttemptsLeft_one: Wrong PIN. 1 try left before you need to sign in again.
unlock.connectionError: Couldn’t connect. Check your connection and try again.
unlock.signInAgain: Sign in again with online banking

splash.slogan: Watching over the ones who watch over you.
